However, Maye also threw three interceptions, all coming in the first half. Green Bay capitalized on the turnovers, building a 24-14 halftime lead after taking advantage of New England's early mistakes. top.title: Another QB injury: Drew Lock’s status ‘up in the air’ for Week 10 vs. Raiders
top.description: It might be Jalen Milroe time for the Seattle Seahawks. While Drew Lock didn’t miss any game action during Seattle’s 17-3 win over the Arizona Cardinals, he has a new injury on top of the severe tendinitis he reportedly had been battling over the past couple of weeks. Lock was seen grabbing his right hip area during the third quarter of Sunday’s game, grimacing and walking gingerly as he got off the field prior to Seattle’s final scoring drive. Jalen Milroe warmed up on the sidelines while Lock went into the blue tent, but Lock stayed in for the rest of the afternoon and didn’t miss a play. Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald told reporters at the post-game press conference that Lock’s status is “up in the air” after getting his oblique looked at. “We’re looking at him for an oblique, so we’ll assess it and go from there,” Macdonald said. “He made it out [of the game], but you know, like I’ve sat here before and told you a guy would be ready and then he wasn’t. So, leave my options open.” For what it’s worth, Lock said “we’ll get it looked at [Sunday night]” and that it “was not too bad.” When asked if the injury affected him, he said, “I wouldn’t say it did.” The Seahawks talk about having a “70-man roster,” knowing they’ll frequently need contributions from beyond the 53. With six starters down, this was one of those weeks. Mike Macdonald said it showed “the power of our 70” and called Drew Lock “a beast” for playing through injury. pic.twitter.com/rp7ZM3vgeo — Brady Henderson (@BradyHenderson) November 9, 2026 Lock also said he felt “good” playing through the elbow injury. Odds are not sounding favorable for Sam Darnold to return against the Las Vegas Raiders, with ESPN’s Adam Schefter reporting what felt like a pretty obvious situation that he is in “jeopardy” of missing Week 10 with quad and rib injuries. If Darnold was listed as “week-to-week” by Mike Macdonald, this isn’t earth-shattering news as much as it affirms what’s already been said. If the news is negative on Lock, then we could see Jalen Milroe’s first career NFL start. But at the minimum, this is a very banged up Seahawks quarterback room and the bye week might be one of the most welcome byes in recent Seahawks history.

top.title: Jordan Love, Packers offense give Patriots' $135 million cornerback nightmares
top.description: The passes arc with a sense of predetermination these days when Jordan Love uncorks another deep ball. The intended target is certainly going to have a chance to catch the ball, and odds are he has some degree of separation against the doomed coverage. What’s less of a guarantee is whether the pass catcher will perform his duty and complete the grab, but that was not an issue during the Packers ’ 45-27 victory over the New England Patriots on Sunday, Nov. 8. The numbers are cartoonish, as Green Bay put up a season high in points and total yards (478) – the worst rushing team in the NFL entering the week scored three times on the ground and ran for 129 yards with running back Josh Jacobs sidelined for most of the game after suffering a broken finger. Love finished with 372 yards passing and three scores through the air and added a rushing touchdown to kick off the scoring 101 seconds into the game to create a well-balanced stat sheet. The one-two punch in the wide-receiver room of Christian Watson and Matthew Golden showed out with a combined 17 receptions on 18 targets for 335 yards and two touchdowns. “It’s bombs away,” NBC’s Jason Garrett said during “Football Night in America.” Fellow NBC analyst Mike Tomlin said it was time to consider the tandem among the elite duos in the league “at the tip-top of the food chain.” Mike Vrabel criticizes Christian Gonzalez after Patriots' loss The performance put Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel in position to criticize one of his best players in cornerback Christian Gonzalez. Signed to a four-year, $135 million extension that made him one of the richest corners in the NFL, Gonzalez was targeted by Love 11 times. He was successful on 10 of those occasions, for 187 yards and a touchdown. “When your best players don’t play well, it’s hard to win in this league,” Vrabel said. The 2025 Coach of the Year continued: “We expect a lot more. He expects a lot more. We need more from him and everybody else. It wasn't just him. Again, we got to be able to coach and be prepared, and then we have to execute. Just like it is every single week when we don't win, it's all of us, and it starts with me.” By the end of the first quarter, Golden had 126 receiving yards. Love completed seven passes that went for 24 yards or more and averaged 12.8 yards per attempt. He was 6-for-8 on deep passes (20+ air yards) for 235 yards and a touchdown, according to Next Gen Stats. It marked the second time Love completed six deep passes this season (Week 5 against the Chicago Bears was the other) – no other quarterback in the NFL has done it once in 2026. "It feels like you're in that flow state and just finding ways to get guys the ball ... it's a great feeling, and you just want to keep chasing every play and keep making good plays," Love told reporters. top.title: Coco Gauff powers past Jessica Pegula in WTA Finals opener
top.description: FILE PHOTO - US tennis player Coco Gauff in action against Czech's Karolina Muchova during their women's singles semi-final match on day eleven of the 2026 Wimbledon Championships at the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club, London. (is associated with: «Coco Gauff powers past Jessica Pegula in WTA Finals opener») Mike Egerton/PA Wire/dpa Coco Gauff overcame Jessica Pegula 6-4, 6-7 (5-7), 6-2 with a dominant third-set display to open her WTA Finals campaign. The world number four took the opener and recovered from 5-1 down in the second to come within a point of winning in straight sets. But it was Pegula’s turn to dig in from 5-6, saving a match point and then playing a terrific tie-break to extend the contest at Indian Wells. Gauff took charge of the match in the third set, breaking to lead 3-0 before earning her sixth win against Pegula after two hours and 39 minutes. Pegula would probably have been grateful to get the tennis under way after her viral and awkward ‘hot mic’ moment when disparaging comments she made about fellow player Mirra Andreeva to her coach during a training session were picked up on a livestream. That prompted a grovelling apology from the WTA, which admitted it had not told players the microphones were on, and damage control behind the scenes from Pegula. The world number five had compared Andreeva’s mentality unfavourably with Gauff’s in her indiscreet comments, and the two-time grand slam champion set about showing her competitive grit, clawing her way back with five games in a row, including saving three set points. Sometime doubles partners Gauff and Pegula had shared their 10 previous meetings, while this was the fourth year in a row they were meeting at the WTA Finals. Earlier, Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova marked her debut with a 6-2, 6-4 victory against alternate Marta Kostyuk. Kostyuk received a late call-up after world number one Elena Rybakina pulled out through illness, but it was Czech Noskova who came out on top.

top.title: 5 takeaways as Patriots lose in embarrassing fashion to Green Bay Packers
top.description: FOXBOROUGH – Gillette Stadium was rocking on Sunday. Before the Patriots ’ matchup with the Green Bay Packers , the organization honored the tenth anniversary of their 2016 Super Bowl team. The pre-game festivities saw several players from that team come onto the field for a short ceremony. Adding to the atmosphere was Tom Brady, who was up in the TV booth as a color commentator for Fox Sports. On top of that, Rob Gronkowski was being honored at halftime after being inducted into the Patriots Hall of Fame. The home crowd was buzzing until the game started. That’s when the Patriots ran into a buzzsaw and sleepwalked through a terrible, no-good, very bad first quarter. The Gillette Stadium crowd was booing the Patriots at various points throughout the first half. Those boos continued Sunday as Mike Vrabel’s team was dominated from start to finish in this embarrassing 45-27 loss to the Packers. The 45 points allowed is the most by a Patriots team since 1990. The Patriots fell to 5-4 with a matchup against the Detroit Lions in Munich on deck. Here’s what happened: First quarter was abysmal The Patriots offense didn’t start fast on Sunday. Neither did the defense. The offense’s first two plays were disastrous as Drake Maye’s group helped the Packers take an early 7-0 lead. It took the Packers no time to take a 14-0 lead in a woeful first quarter. The offense’s first play of the game was an illegal shift penalty. Their second was even worse as Maye was easily intercepted by Packers safety Xavier McKinney at 14:32 of the first quarter. Maye was trying to connect with Mack Hollins, but threw the ball right to McKinney, who ran back 36 yards and set Green Bay up at the 14-yard line. It took the Packers two plays to get into the end zone with quarterback Jordan Love running in a 13-yard touchdown at 13:19 of the first quarter. After the Patriots went three-and-out in their next series, the Packers beat up on the defense. Love completed a 49-yard pass to Matthew Golden, setting up Green Bay at the 18-yard line. Next, Christian Gonzalez was called for a pass interference penalty, which negated an interception he had. That set Green Bay up at the 9-yard line. Two plays later, Golden was left wide open for an easy 5-yard touchdown pass at 7:59 of this no-good, very bad first quarter. To make it even more disappointing, Kyle Williams had a chance to make a 47-yard touchdown catch but the receiver misjudged the deep ball, slowed down and the ball fell between his outstretched fingers in the end zone at 5:38 of the first quarter. top.description: FOXBOROUGH — An already-thin running back room got thinner on Sunday for the Patriots against the Packers . Rhamondre Stevenson suffered a knee injury in the third quarter and was ruled out. Stevenson remained down after a play, but walked off the field and into the blue medical tent. He eventually made his way to the locker room for further evaluation. The Patriots were down 42-21 when Stevenson was ruled out. It’s possible it was just precautionary due to the score. With TreVeyon Henderson (illness) out for the foreseeable future, the Patriots can ill-afford to lose another running back, especially with A.J. Brown (knee, ankle) and Romeo Doubs (shoulder) out. It’s unclear when the trio will return. Stevenson lost a fumble in the third quarter. The Packers scored a touchdown on the first play of the drive after the recovery. Before the injury, Stevenson had six carries for 32 rushing yards to go with three receptions, 46 receiving yards and a touchdown. top.title: Denver Nuggets Suddenly Add Nikola Jokic to Injury Report Before Rockets Game
top.description: Denver Nuggets' center #15 Nikola Jokic takes part in a practice session on the eve of the NBA basketball game between Indiana Pacers and Denver Nuggets in Mexico City on November 6, 2026. (Photo by Carl DE SOUZA / AFP via Getty Images) Getty The Denver Nuggets added Nikola Jokic to the injury report for the first time this season, listing the three-time MVP as questionable for Monday’s game against the Houston Rockets with a right elbow sprain. Jokic has played in all eight games for Denver, which improved to 5-3 with Saturday’s 114-102 win over the Indiana Pacers in Mexico City. Now he’s one of six Nuggets listed as questionable on the NBA’s Sunday injury report. That group includes all five players who started against Indiana. Nikola Jokic’s Elbow Injury Follows an Up-and-Down Shooting Start Jokic went 7-for-20 from the floor against Indiana, finishing with 19 points, 13 rebounds and eight assists in 36 minutes. Three days earlier, he went 13-for-19 in a win over Toronto and finished with 32 points, 10 rebounds and 11 assists. The two performances capture how much his scoring efficiency has swung through Denver’s first eight games. It started on opening night, when Jokic scored 13 points on 5-for-19 shooting against Oklahoma City. He followed that with 35 points, 15 rebounds and 10 assists against New Orleans. Through eight games, he’s averaging 22.9 points, 10.1 rebounds and 9.1 assists, according to his CBS Sports game log. The elbow sprain adds a new question to those shooting swings. Denver’s report gives no date for the injury, so it’s unclear whether the elbow was bothering Jokic during any of those games. Even on the tougher shooting nights, the rest of his game has held up. He had 11 assists against Golden State on Oct. 26 and was two assists shy of a triple-double against Indiana. Nuggets Injury Report Lists All Five Starters Against Rockets Denver started Jokic, Jamal Murray, Christian Braun, Cameron Johnson and Aaron Gordon against Indiana. All five are questionable for Monday’s 8:30 p.m. ET tipoff in Houston. DeMar DeRozan is also questionable, while Julian Strawther is the lone Denver player ruled out on Sunday’s report. top.title: Every player from California to play for the Brooklyn Nets - Corey Gaines
top.description: The Brooklyn Nets have signed, drafted, and traded for players from virtually every state in the US, and much of the wider world beyond the United States. From Alabama to Wyoming, and from Australia to Ukraine, the Nets have a long and distinguished history of turning over every stone to find the talent needed to succeed in the NBA. From their start in the American Basketball Association (ABA) as the New Jersey Americans and New York Nets to their jump to the NBA as the New Jersey Nets right through to today, the organization has cast their net for talent wide since the inception of the ball club. For this installment of our series documenting the provenience of every Nets player to suit up for the franchise, let's take a look at every player from California who has played for Brooklyn. Our focus in this article is Corey Gaines. An alum of Loyola Marymount, he was picked up with the 66th overall selection of the 1988 NBA Draft by the Seattle SuperSonics. The Los Angeles, California native played the first season of his pro career with the (then) New Jersey (now, Brooklyn) Nets instead, coming to an end when he signed with the Denver Nuggets in 1989. top.title: Houston Rockets jersey history No. 41 - Larry Moffett (1977-78)
top.description: The Houston Rockets have had players donning a total of 52 different jersey numbers (and have one not part of any numerical series for Houston assistant coach and general manager Carroll Dawson) since their founding at the start of the 1967-68 season, worn by just under 500 players in the course of Rockets history. top.title: How Carlos Alcaraz and Rafael Nadal performed on their ATP Finals debuts as Rafael Jodar qualifies for 2026 event
top.description: Rafael Jodar has achieved the unthinkable. The Spanish starlet has qualified for the ATP Finals, despite only turning professional at the start of this year . Jodar secured the eighth and final ATP Finals qualification spot following Carlos Alcaraz’s stunning comeback victory against Taylor Fritz in the Paris Masters quarter-finals. Speaking of Alcaraz, let’s take a look at how the Spanish magician – and fellow Spanish tennis legend Rafael Nadal – fared on his ATP Finals debut. Carlos Alcaraz’s ATP Finals debut Alcaraz qualified for the 2022 ATP Finals after winning his first Grand Slam title at the 2022 US Open. Unfortunately for the Spaniard, he was ultimately forced to withdraw from the event due to injury. Alcaraz again qualified in 2023, and on this occasion, injury would not prevent the Spaniard from making his tournament debut. Alcaraz, seeded second at the 2023 ATP Finals, advanced to the semi-finals after defeating Daniil Medvedev and Andrey Rublev in the group stage. Novak Djokovic swiftly ended Alcaraz’s hopes of a debut triumph, winning their semi-final contest 6-3, 6-2. “Best match of the tournament for me without a doubt,” Djokovic said afterwards. “It came at the right time, really, after spending a lot of hours on the court in the first three matches. I didn’t know how I’m going to feel. Carlos Alcaraz’s 2026 ATP Finals campaign Group stage: defeated Daniil Medvedev 6-4, 6-4 Group stage: defeated Andrey Rublev 7-5, 6-2 Group stage: lost to Alexander Zverev, 7-6, 3-6, 4-6 Semi-finals: lost to Novak Djokovic 3-6, 2-6 “But tonight from the very beginning I felt the ball well. I was approaching the match with the right attitude, right mentality.” Djokovic went on to win a record-breaking seventh ATP Finals title, beating Jannik Sinner in the final. Rafael Nadal’s ATP Finals debut Nadal, a 22-time Grand Slam champion, made his ATP Finals [then the Tennis Masters Cup] debut in 2006. Like Alcaraz, the Spanish superstar reached the semi-finals, beating Nikolay Davydenko and Tommy Robredo en route. Nadal, who qualified second in his group behind eighth seed James Blake, was beaten by Roger Federer in the semi-finals. Photo by FREDERIC J. BROWN / AFP via Getty Images “I am satisfied for finish the season with my best game, satisfied for that, because you finish the season with a very good feelings. That’s very important. And I am satisfied with my semifinal, yes,” Nadal said during his post-match press conference. “I win two matches against the two top eight players. And I lost against the No. 1 now today, but playing at very good level and good match, no? “So I am happy with the tournament, yes.” As for Federer, the Swiss star went on to the win the title in Shanghai, China, defeating James Blake in the final. The occasion marked Federer’s third ATP Finals title. Federer went on to win six titles in total, the last being in 2011. Despite reaching the final on two occasions, Nadal never won the ATP Finals.

nigeria.description: By Rotimi Ojomoyela ADO-EKITI — A chieftain of the All Progressives Congress (APC) and member of the President Bola Tinubu/APC 2027 Presidential Campaign Council, Engineer Atinuke Owolabi, has expressed concern over the low voter turnout in Aramoko-Ekiti during the 2023 presidential election, saying about 73 per cent of registered voters in the community did not participate. Owolabi, who is also the convener of PBAT-MOB Aramoko Community Engagement, spoke during an APC voter education exercise and community engagement in Aramoko, Ekiti Central Senatorial District, over the weekend. The programme, organised in support of the re-election bids of President Tinubu and Senate Leader, Senator Michael Opeyemi Bamidele, was held under the theme, “My Vote, My Voice”. She also represents the South-West as a member of the North Central Development Commission. Owolabi said voter education was essential to strengthening democracy, particularly in rural communities where inadequate information about electoral procedures could discourage participation or lead to invalid votes. Presenting figures from the 2023 presidential election, she said Ekiti State had 988,923 registered voters, out of whom 315,058 were accredited, while 308,171 valid votes were recorded and 6,301 ballots were rejected. She said available ward-level records for Aramoko I and Aramoko II showed a combined 17,426 registered voters, compared with 4,680 votes reportedly cast during the presidential election. According to her, the figures indicated that approximately 12,746 registered voters did not participate, representing about 73 per cent of the electorate in the two wards. She urged residents to improve their participation in future elections, stressing the need for the community to translate its voting strength into meaningful democratic engagement. Owolabi said the exercise was designed to educate residents on voting procedures, encourage participation and reduce the number of rejected ballots. The programme also featured the unveiling of a voter education handbook intended to guide residents on electoral processes, identification of polling units and the proper use of their Permanent Voter Cards (PVCs). She said: “I believe voter education is key. If we cannot completely eliminate rejected votes, we should at least be able to reduce them in Ekiti State, particularly in Aramoko, my community. “We are here to sensitise our people on the correct way to vote. When they go to the polling units, they must ensure that they vote correctly. “We have the population, and we have the voters. What is really lacking is adequate information. Our people need to understand the right way to vote. “Today, we have unveiled a voter education handbook, which is a welcome development. nigeria.title: Aba South establishes commercial farms to boost revenue, create jobs
nigeria.description: By Ugochukwu Alaribe UMUAHIA — Aba South Local Government Area of Abia State has established commercial poultry and piggery farms as part of efforts to boost its internally generated revenue (IGR), create jobs and equip residents with skills in animal husbandry. The Executive Chairman of the council, Chief Obialo Anyanwu, disclosed this while briefing journalists on his administration’s two-year achievements, explaining that the initiative was aimed at making the local government more financially self-reliant. Anyanwu said his administration was exploring sustainable revenue sources to strengthen the council’s capacity to deliver services rather than depend entirely on external funding. He explained that the farms would also serve as training centres where residents would acquire practical skills in animal farming, enabling them to establish their own businesses and employ others. He said: “We don’t believe in all these 10kg of rice empowerment. What we want in Aba South is giving our people that level of empowerment that will make them self-sustaining and employ others. So, we’ll teach the techniques needed to succeed in the business. “The three buildings in the poultry section are up, two are already roofed, and the staff quarters are at the lintel stage because it’s a proper farm and people must reside there. “Possibly by the end of the year, everything will take off. So, we’re envisaging such a future. We, as the third tier of government, must stand for ourselves, and it has pushed us into doing commercial poultry and commercial pig farming.” The chairman disclosed that the poultry farm occupies 14 plots of land, while the piggery farm covers seven plots. He added that the projects would generate revenue for the council, create employment opportunities and provide practical agricultural training for residents, including staff of the council’s agriculture department. On healthcare, Anyanwu said the council had established and equipped 22 Glycoster World Primary Healthcare Centres in partnership with the Abia State Government. nigeria.title: Trump admits his mass deportation policy was ‘too tough’
nigeria.description: US President Donald Trump said that his mass deportation of undocumented immigrants was “too tough,” according to an excerpt of an interview with CBS aired Sunday. Asked about his deportation policy, Trump told CBS’ “60 Minutes”: “I think it was too tough…I think it might be too tough.” The excerpt was published by CBS on X ahead of a broadcast of the interview on network TV later Sunday. It was recorded after the Republican Party’s heavy loss in midterm elections on Tuesday. While Trump has won some domestic support for securing the US southern border, his administration’s aggressive push to deport millions of undocumented migrants has drawn widespread criticism. However, Trump on Friday appointed the architect of that hardline policy, Stephen Miller, as his chief of staff on Friday, signaling a bare-knuckle fightback after the Republican election loss. Miller has been synonymous with scenes of masked immigration agents committing violence after he backed federal agents who shot and killed two Americans early this year. nigeria.title: Sultan directs Muslims to sight Jumada Assaniya moon Monday
nigeria.description: By Musa Ubandawaki, Sokoto SOKOTO – The Sultanate Council of Sokoto has called on Muslims across Nigeria to search for the new crescent moon of Jumada Assaniya 1448AH on Monday, November 9, 2026. The directive was contained in a statement dated November 8, 2026, signed by Professor Sambo Wali Junaidu and made available to journalists on Sunday. According to the statement, the Advisory Committee on Religious Affairs of the Sultanate Council identified Monday as the 29th day of Jumada al-Ula 1448AH and the appropriate date for the nationwide moon-sighting exercise. The council urged Muslims across the country to actively participate in the exercise by looking out for the new crescent moon after sunset on Monday. It specifically requested anyone who sights the crescent to promptly report the observation to the nearest District or Village Head for onward transmission to His Eminence, Alhaji Muhammad Sa’ad Abubakar, CFR, mni, the Sultan of Sokoto and President-General of the Nigeria Supreme Council for Islamic Affairs (NSCIA). The council stressed the importance of timely and credible reports of confirmed sightings to enable the Sultan to make the appropriate religious announcement on the commencement of the new Islamic month. It noted that the Sultan remains the recognised authority responsible for communicating the outcome of the moon-sighting exercise to Muslims across the country. The announcement underscores the role of the Sultanate Council in coordinating Islamic religious affairs and guiding the Muslim Ummah on matters concerning the Islamic lunar calendar. In a prayer, Professor Sambo Wali Junaidu, Waziri and Chairman of the Advisory Committee on Religious Affairs of the Sultanate Council, asked Allah (SWT) to grant Muslims the guidance and strength to discharge the religious responsibility successfully. The council also prayed for divine assistance and acceptance of the exercise, urging Muslims to approach the assignment with sincerity, vigilance and a strong sense of religious commitment. nigeria.title: Fermin brace earns Liga leaders Barcelona 2-1 win at Atletico
nigeria.description: Fermin Lopez struck twice to help Barcelona come from behind to beat Atletico Madrid 2-1 and move three points clear at the top of La Liga. The Spanish champions lead second place Real Madrid, who beat Valencia 3-0 on Saturday, with Atletico third, now five points behind. Giuliano Simeone fired Atletico ahead in a high-octane start, before Lopez pulled Barca level shortly before the interval at the Metropolitano stadium. The 23-year-old Spain international netted the winner after 66 minutes when Lamine Yamal slipped him in. The match started at a fast pace and both teams hit the woodwork in the opening stages. Alvarez, who tried and failed to force a move from Atletico to Barca in the summer, rounded goalkeeper Joan Garcia but could not finish off the chance as the defence blocked his route to goal. From the resulting corner Atletico defender Marc Pubill headed against the crossbar with Garcia beaten. At the other end Pedri crashed a strike against the woodwork after being fed by Barca’s teenage star Lamine Yamal. Atletico took the lead in the 10th minute, slicing Barca’s defence open. Alvarez crossed for Giuliano Simeone to turn home from close range. The game settled down after that pulsating start, although Alvarez came close to scoring Atletico’s second. The Argentine international’s shot was fumbled by Garcia, but the goalkeeper was able to collect the ball quickly afterwards. Yamal blasted into the side-netting from a tight angle with Barcelona not able to click into their top gears. Despite their struggles they went in level at the break, with a goal out of nowhere. Lopez’s path to the box was blocked but the ball bounced loose to the midfielder and he quickly smashed a strike past Jan Oblak. Early in the second half Alvarez lobbed over the crossbar when running in on goal. The forward came to rue the miss when Barcelona took the lead. Yamal played a clever pass through Atletico’s defence and Lopez kept his cool to beat Oblak. It was his seventh league goal in 11 top flight appearances this season. Barcelona kept Atletico at bay well in the final stages to take three points home from the capital before the international break. nigeria.title: 2027 Elections: Lagos APC Candidate Hamzat Promises 4,000 CNG Buses, 77 Electric Ferries
nigeria.description: The Lagos State governorship candidate of the All Progressives Congress (APC), Obafemi Hamzat, has promised to deploy 4,000 compressed natural gas (CNG) buses to move one million passengers daily as part of plans to ease transportation challenges in the state. Hamzat, the incumbent Deputy Governor, also disclosed plans to expand water transportation with 77 electric ferries and improve connectivity between different parts of Lagos through an integrated transport system. ﻿ He made the promises on Sunday during the Lagos governorship debate organised by the Nigeria Debate Consortium, comprising Channels Television, TVC News, Punch Newspaper, The Cable, and Vanguard Newspaper. Explaining his transportation plans, Hamzat said the objective was to reduce commuting time and give residents more opportunities to rest and spend time with their families. “The plan is to give back time to the citizens to plan, to rest, to spend with their family. There’s nowhere in Africa that the private sector has funded a rail. “Since BRT started, it has done 77 million journeys; that is with 1,000 buses. My plan says we will push it to 4,000 buses; the idea is to move one million people a day with 4,000 CNG buses, meaning up to 5,000, create BRt lane from Marina to Epe, from Marina to Badagry and so on and so forth,” he said. “Today, over four million people have the Cowry card. What does that mean? It means you can use ferry, you can use rail, and you can use BRT buses — one payment — so that we can deal with how to subsidise it. On healthcare, the APC candidate promised to expand access to medical services by increasing the number of primary healthcare centres providing round-the-clock services. nigeria.title: Seven killed, over 100 injured in Egypt train collision
nigeria.description: At least seven people have been killed and more than 100 injured after two trains collided near Giza, Egypt, causing several carriages to derail and plunge down an embankment. The country’s railway authority said the trains, travelling south from Giza and Cairo, collided in the area between Kafr Ammar and Al-Raqqa stations in Al-Ayyat. Egypt’s President, Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, said he had directed relevant authorities to investigate the circumstances surrounding the accident and ensure that anyone found negligent was held accountable. The public prosecutor’s office warned that the death toll could rise as rescue and recovery operations continued. The government said hospitals in the affected area had been placed on heightened alert to handle the large number of casualties. Health Minister, Dr Khaled Abdel Ghaffar, said victims were receiving treatment for various injuries, including broken bones and head injuries. The Egyptian Red Crescent also deployed personnel to provide emergency assistance and psychological support to victims and their families at the scene. The ministry confirmed that the driver of one of the trains was among those killed in the collision. According to reports, the first train was travelling from Giza to Fayoum when it crashed into the rear of another train heading from Cairo to Aswan, which was stationary on the tracks. Photographs from the scene showed several overturned carriages, with emergency responders and members of the public searching through the wreckage for survivors. Train services between Giza and the Upper Egypt region were suspended as cranes were deployed to remove the damaged trains. The railway authority had yet to announce when services would resume. The crash occurred close to the location of Egypt’s deadliest railway disaster, which happened in February 2002 when a fire engulfed a passenger train travelling from Cairo to Luxor, killing more than 370 people officially, although some estimates put the death toll higher. Two other train accidents in the area in 2009 also claimed dozens of lives. The latest disaster sparked calls on Sunday for Egypt’s transport minister to resign over the recurring railway accidents. Meanwhile, foreign governments and diplomatic representatives expressed condolences and solidarity with Egypt over the tragedy. Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs expressed solidarity with Egypt and wished the injured a speedy recovery. Turkey’s Ambassador to Egypt also conveyed his condolences on X to the victims, their families and the Egyptian people. nigeria.title: No Political Will To Deal With Agberos In Lagos, Says NDC’s Funsho Doherty
nigeria.description: The governorship candidate of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) in Lagos State, Funsho Doherty, has blamed the persistence of the agbero system in the state on a lack of political will by successive administrations to reform the transport sector. Agberos are transport touts who collect money from commercial bus drivers and other transport operators at motor parks, bus stops and along roads, often claiming to represent transport unions or park authorities. Speaking during the Lagos Governorship Debate on Sunday, Doherty said powerful interests within the existing transport system had made it difficult for successive governments to tackle the activities of the operators. The debate was organised by the Nigeria Debate Consortium, a coalition of five media organisations: Channels Television, TVC News, The PUNCH, TheCable and Vanguard Newspapers. “Many of us understand this notion of the agbero system that people talk about. There is no political will to deal with that problem,” Doherty said. He argued that meaningful reform of public transportation would require a government that was accountable to residents rather than interests benefiting from the existing arrangement. “We will modernise the transportation system because we will be elected by the people, not by an agbero network,” he said. nigeria.title: Police arrest six suspected phone thieves at Makinde’s Bauchi rally
nigeria.description: By Christopher Ameh, Bauchi The Bauchi State Police Command has arrested six suspected phone thieves accused of stealing mobile phones from participants at the presidential campaign flag-off of the Allied Peoples’ Movement (APM) candidate, Governor Seyi Makinde, in the state. The suspects were arrested by operatives of the Police Violent Crimes Response Unit (VCRU), deployed to provide security at the campaign venue, following the detection of their suspicious movements during the event. The Police Public Relations Officer, SP Nafiu Habib, disclosed this in a statement on Sunday, saying exhibits were recovered from four of the suspects, while two others were identified by a victim as allegedly responsible for stealing his phone. The suspects were identified as Muhammad Rabiu, 20; Ibrahim Abubakar, 25; Hamza Usman, 18; Abba Bala, 20; Auwal Muhammad, 23; and Inusa Adamu, 20. Items recovered from them included an itel torchlight phone, an OPPO Android phone, an Infinix Smart 20 phone and a 20,000mAh power bank. The police spokesman said a Samsung Fold 4 allegedly stolen during the event had yet to be recovered, adding that efforts were being intensified to retrieve the device and other missing valuables. He said investigation was ongoing and that the suspects would be charged to court upon its conclusion. The Commissioner of Police, Sani-Omolori Aliyu, commended the operatives for their vigilance and prompt action, which led to the arrests and recovery of some stolen items. He warned criminal elements against exploiting public gatherings and political events to perpetrate crime, stressing that the command would not relent in its efforts to rid the state of criminal activities. The commissioner also urged members of the public attending political rallies and other public events to remain vigilant, safeguard their valuables and promptly report suspicious movements to security operatives. He called for continued public cooperation through the provision of timely and credible information to assist the command in preventing and controlling crime. nigeria.title: Police rescue five kidnap victims, arrest three suspects in Kebbi
nigeria.description: By Haruna Aliyu, Birnin Kebbi The Kebbi State Police Command has rescued five kidnapped victims and arrested three suspects following a coordinated security operation in Dakingari, Suru Local Government Area of the state. The Police Public Relations Officer, SP Bashir Usman Kebbi, disclosed this in a statement on Sunday, saying the operation followed credible intelligence that armed men had invaded Dolen Kwandage Village and abducted three residents. The victims were identified as Samaila Abubakar, 35; Dayyaba Muhammadu, 32; and Balki Hakimi, 31. According to the statement, police operatives, working in collaboration with local vigilantes, swiftly mobilised to the area and pursued the assailants. The police said the superior firepower of the security team forced the kidnappers to abandon their captives, leading to the rescue of the three newly abducted residents and two other women who had earlier been held in captivity. The two women were identified as Moe Muddaha, 50, and Hadiza Bello, 30, both from Yarma Village in Suru LGA. All five victims were rescued unhurt and taken to the General Hospital, Dakingari, for medical examination before being reunited with their families. The operation also led to the arrest of three suspects identified as Umaru Janyo, 49, and Bube Kwaire, 28, both from Bendu Village, and Muhammadu Gyade, 22, of Tindifai Village. The police said other members of the criminal gang escaped with suspected gunshot injuries. Items recovered during the operation included an unregistered Haojue motorcycle, ₦308,000 in cash, a chain and a jerrycan. The command said it had intensified security patrols and surveillance in the area, adding that efforts were ongoing to track down the fleeing suspects and bring all those involved to justice. The Commissioner of Police, CP Umar M. Hadejia, commended the operatives and their local vigilante collaborators for their prompt response, courage and effective coordination. He reiterated the command’s commitment to protecting lives and property, disrupting criminal networks and ensuring that perpetrators of violent crimes were brought to justice. Hadejia also urged members of the public to continue providing timely and credible information to security agencies to strengthen collective security efforts. nigeria.title: 2027: Makinde backs state police, vows security overhaul
nigeria.description: By Golok Nanmwa JOS – Oyo State Governor and presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples’ Movement (APM), Seyi Makinde, has backed the establishment of state police, pledging to decentralise Nigeria’s security architecture if elected president in the 2027 general elections. Makinde stated this on Sunday during a live political programme on Jay FM 101.9 in Jos, Plateau State, where he outlined his proposed security reforms ahead of the party’s presidential campaign activities in the city. “I believe that we need to decentralise our security architecture. State police is one of the ways to achieve this, but it must be properly structured. “States that are ready should be allowed to establish their own police formations, while others can come on board when they are prepared,” he said. Recalling his engagement with former President Muhammadu Buhari on the issue in 2019, Makinde said the former president had expressed concerns about the ability of some states to fund their police formations. “When we approached President Buhari in 2019, one of the concerns he raised was that some states could not even pay workers’ salaries. He questioned how such states would be able to fund state police,” he said. Speaking at the briefing, the National Public Relations Officer of the NCS, Deputy Comptroller Abdullahi Aliyu Maiwada, said the performance reflected the Service’s commitment to facilitating legitimate trade, improving cargo clearance and strengthening revenue generation through digital interventions and collaboration with stakeholders. Similarly, 48,832 SGDs were processed in September, while 51,007 were recorded in October, giving a combined total of 99,839 declarations. In a statement, Maiwada also disclosed that the Service recorded significant progress in export trade facilitation. At the Lilypond Export Command, export activities in the third quarter of 2026 generated a total export value of $752.85 million, compared with $586.15 million recorded in the corresponding period of 2025. business.description: Bitcoin Magazine U.S. Treasury Cuts Off MEXC From U.S. Financial System Over Alleged $16 Billion in Illicit Flows The U.S. Treasury’s Financial Crimes Enforcement Network issued a final order Friday that will cut offshore exchange MEXC Global off from the American banking system over alleged links to sanctions evasion by Iran, North Korea and Russia, the department said . FinCEN’s order, published as a PDF pending Federal Register placement, finds MEXC a “primary money laundering concern in connection with Russian illicit finance” under section 9714(a) of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act. Thirty days after that Register notice, covered U.S. financial institutions will be barred from any funds transfer — including convertible virtual currency — to or from MEXC. Reuters reported the same cut-off Friday afternoon. Treasury framed the move as part of Operation Economic Outcast. It is not an OFAC sanctions designation: the order says it does not rewrite Bank Secrecy Act duties or OFAC rules, and it is a FinCEN funds-transmittal ban rather than a Section 311 proposed rulemaking. Treasury alleges MEXC facilitated at least $16 billion in illicit flows from May 2021 through May 2026, including nearly $1.5 billion tied to Russian sanctions evasion and about $22 million linked to Iran’s Central Bank and the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps’ Qods Force. The platform was still processing trades with sanctioned Garantex and successor Grinex as recently as June 2026, more than four years after OFAC designated Garantex, the release says. What the order does — and when The order , signed by FinCEN Deputy Director Jimmy L. Kirby, covers MEXC Global and named affiliates operating outside the United States, including Seychelles-incorporated MEXC Global Ltd / MX Global Ltd, Estonia’s MEXC Estonia OÜ, Switzerland’s GIDA Technology AG and the U.K.’s MXC Global Ltd, plus successors. Covered institutions face civil or criminal penalties for willful violations. Until the Federal Register publishes the notice, the 30-day clock has not started. As of Friday evening eastern time the Register’s public index still showed no MEXC document, matching the order’s own cover note that publication is pending. Background on MEXC Founded in 2018 and formerly branded MXC, MEXC ranks among the world’s 20 largest centralized crypto venues by volume. entertainment.description: With Earth & Sky , her Spring/Summer 2027 collection, Banke Kuku turns to nature’s most essential cycle: the sky gives rain, the rain feeds the earth, and the earth gives back. Reimagining the water cycle as a circle of life, the collection celebrates the abundance that flows from it. Earth & Sky is built around seven prints in three families. The Sky family is led by the hero print, Bougainvillea Sky, with watercolour bougainvillea, bees, butterflies and birds drifting across a turquoise ground, alongside Dove Sky and Daybreak Sky. The Earth family, Yellow Trumpet and Flower Bud, draws on flowering plants such as Costus spectabilis . The Rain family pairs Raindrop, a glossy, near-photographic print set against the softness of the watercolours, with the Kuku Monogram in fresh colourways. Sky prints are finished with hand-embroidered clouds and raindrops on flowing kaftans and kimono robes. Speaking on the inspiration, Creative Director Banke Kuku shares: “I never start with a sketch. I start with a feeling, and for Earth & Sky, that feeling was abundance. This year I became a mother for the first time, and everywhere I looked, nature was reflecting that same fullness back at me. This is my most personal collection.” A CYCLE OF GIVING BACK In nature, nothing is wasted, and everything returns. Earth & Sky carries that principle as its message: what we take from the earth, we must give back. That principle extends into how Banke Kuku approaches production. The brand maintains a no-waste policy, finding uses for offcuts rather than discarding them, while its seasonless approach allows pieces to remain part of the collection beyond a single season. Banke Kuku also uses digital printing, which consumes less heat and water than conventional printing methods, and continues to reduce its use of man-made fabrics in favour of more conscious material choices. Its commitment to the natural world extends beyond its collections, including its work with the Nigerian Conservation Foundation and its Re-Green Movement, which supports afforestation and the restoration of Nigeria’s natural environment. entertainment.title: Adaugo Nwankpa: What a Career Transition Taught Me About Starting Over
entertainment.description: One year and two months ago, I took a career pivot. I moved from being a digital media professional writing stories, articles and shaping narratives to becoming an analyst in the energy sector, working across the oil and gas and renewable subsectors. The journey across these two industries that are worlds apart has taught me lessons on starting over You are never really starting from scratch No matter what you are starting over at or what you are getting into, it is important to realise that you are never truly starting from zero. Where ‘zero’ means the state of having nothing: skills, experience, network, intelligence, and others. While it may indeed appear that you do not have the things you consider as being critical to starting over, you actually have what you have: the knowledge, skills and experiences that have shaped your life and marked your journey up to this present moment, and this is invaluable. Also, having a strong knowledge of yourself is also an incredible resource when starting over, as it helps you to discern and differentiate challenges that are due to your personality, and challenges that are due to the circumstance of starting over. Your ‘Next Best Move’ is hidden within your network When we think of network, it is easy to limit it to close friends, relatives or even acquaintances. This is quite a restrictive and limiting view of the concept of network. Your network also includes ‘strangers’ and your internet community. In my case, I knew of the opportunity in the energy sector through a friend whom I had met on Instagram. It gets more interesting. By the time I was preparing for my first interview, I knew that I had zero knowledge about the current state of the sector. Thanks again to Instagram, I reached out to someone I followed who I knew worked in the sector, and she offered a free virtual coffee chat. I went into the interview more confident in what value I could offer and what mattered for such a role. Transferable skills are invaluable Prior to my career pivot, my only exposure to the energy sector aside from buying fuel and gas was a seminar paper I had written in my final year investigating annual shifts in fuel pump prices. However, I audited my skills and qualifications and noted that I also had highly transferable skills. I had communication, business development and a good knowledge and expertise in using Canva. No matter what you are starting over at, you have something that can be transferred from where you were to where you are or where you want to be. entertainment.description: Nancy Isime ‘s first film as executive producer, from GREOH Studios, is a beautifully shot story about the love that holds a family together when life falls apart. Some films you watch. Others stay with you. Loving Itohan is the second kind. It opens like the love story you think you already know: a radiant bride, an Edo wedding, coral beads and gold everywhere. You settle in for romance. Then, slowly, the film shows you its heart, and it is so much bigger than a love story. At its centre is Itohan, played by Nancy Isime, a woman whose world is shaken by loss and by truths she never saw coming. What follows is a story about grief, the quiet kind that stays in a home long after the visitors have gone. It is about family, the people who hold us up and sometimes weigh us down. And it is about love that has to keep choosing to stay, even when it hurts. You will see yourself in it. In the person trying to hold everyone together. In the things left unsaid at the dinner table. In the slow, uneven way healing actually happens. A film that looks as good as it feels The cinematography deserves its own round of applause. Every frame feels deliberate, from the rich reds and golds of Edo tradition to the close, quiet moments where a single look says everything. The camera knows when to celebrate and when to simply sit with a character in her pain. This is a film made for the big screen. There is a reason it all feels so assured. This time, GREOH goes deep instead, trading spectacle for the messy, tender feelings we all carry. True to form, it also hands the director’s chair to a fresh talent, Orobosa Ikponmwen , the latest in a line of new directors the studio has backed, from Kayode Kasum to Loukman Ali. And for Nancy Isime, this is her very first project as an executive producer. You can feel how much of herself she has poured into it, in front of the camera and behind it. Alongside her, Uzor Arukwe, Martha Ehinome Orhiere, Dorathy Bachor, Grace Dein Coker, Chioma Nwosu, Florence Sunday and newcomer Obehi Aburime bring the family to life. Don’t judge it by the trailer If the trailer has you thinking you know where this is going, trust us, you don’t. Go with someone you love. Bring tissues. And maybe call your mum afterwards. sports.title: Another QB injury: Drew Lock’s status ‘up in the air’ for Week 10 vs. Raiders
sports.description: It might be Jalen Milroe time for the Seattle Seahawks. While Drew Lock didn’t miss any game action during Seattle’s 17-3 win over the Arizona Cardinals, he has a new injury on top of the severe tendinitis he reportedly had been battling over the past couple of weeks. Lock was seen grabbing his right hip area during the third quarter of Sunday’s game, grimacing and walking gingerly as he got off the field prior to Seattle’s final scoring drive. Jalen Milroe warmed up on the sidelines while Lock went into the blue tent, but Lock stayed in for the rest of the afternoon and didn’t miss a play. Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald told reporters at the post-game press conference that Lock’s status is “up in the air” after getting his oblique looked at. “We’re looking at him for an oblique, so we’ll assess it and go from there,” Macdonald said. “He made it out [of the game], but you know, like I’ve sat here before and told you a guy would be ready and then he wasn’t. So, leave my options open.” For what it’s worth, Lock said “we’ll get it looked at [Sunday night]” and that it “was not too bad.” When asked if the injury affected him, he said, “I wouldn’t say it did.” The Seahawks talk about having a “70-man roster,” knowing they’ll frequently need contributions from beyond the 53. With six starters down, this was one of those weeks. Mike Macdonald said it showed “the power of our 70” and called Drew Lock “a beast” for playing through injury. pic.twitter.com/rp7ZM3vgeo — Brady Henderson (@BradyHenderson) November 9, 2026 Lock also said he felt “good” playing through the elbow injury. Odds are not sounding favorable for Sam Darnold to return against the Las Vegas Raiders, with ESPN’s Adam Schefter reporting what felt like a pretty obvious situation that he is in “jeopardy” of missing Week 10 with quad and rib injuries. If Darnold was listed as “week-to-week” by Mike Macdonald, this isn’t earth-shattering news as much as it affirms what’s already been said. If the news is negative on Lock, then we could see Jalen Milroe’s first career NFL start. But at the minimum, this is a very banged up Seahawks quarterback room and the bye week might be one of the most welcome byes in recent Seahawks history.

sports.title: Coco Gauff powers past Jessica Pegula in WTA Finals opener
sports.description: FILE PHOTO - US tennis player Coco Gauff in action against Czech's Karolina Muchova during their women's singles semi-final match on day eleven of the 2026 Wimbledon Championships at the All England Lawn Tennis and Croquet Club, London. (is associated with: «Coco Gauff powers past Jessica Pegula in WTA Finals opener») Mike Egerton/PA Wire/dpa Coco Gauff overcame Jessica Pegula 6-4, 6-7 (5-7), 6-2 with a dominant third-set display to open her WTA Finals campaign. The world number four took the opener and recovered from 5-1 down in the second to come within a point of winning in straight sets. But it was Pegula’s turn to dig in from 5-6, saving a match point and then playing a terrific tie-break to extend the contest at Indian Wells. Gauff took charge of the match in the third set, breaking to lead 3-0 before earning her sixth win against Pegula after two hours and 39 minutes. Pegula would probably have been grateful to get the tennis under way after her viral and awkward ‘hot mic’ moment when disparaging comments she made about fellow player Mirra Andreeva to her coach during a training session were picked up on a livestream. That prompted a grovelling apology from the WTA, which admitted it had not told players the microphones were on, and damage control behind the scenes from Pegula. The world number five had compared Andreeva’s mentality unfavourably with Gauff’s in her indiscreet comments, and the two-time grand slam champion set about showing her competitive grit, clawing her way back with five games in a row, including saving three set points. Sometime doubles partners Gauff and Pegula had shared their 10 previous meetings, while this was the fourth year in a row they were meeting at the WTA Finals. Earlier, Wimbledon champion Linda Noskova marked her debut with a 6-2, 6-4 victory against alternate Marta Kostyuk. Kostyuk received a late call-up after world number one Elena Rybakina pulled out through illness, but it was Czech Noskova who came out on top.

sports.title: Packers Snap Counts, Week 9: Green Bay shakes up the offensive line
sports.description: (Photo by Kathryn Riley/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Green Bay Packers broke the 100-yard rushing mark on Sunday against the New England Patriots , in part because they changed up both their backfield and their offensive line. Will those changes stick moving forward? That hasn’t been determined yet. Let’s get into how this Packers team looked different than in the past in our week’s snap count breakdown. As a reminder, these only include offensive and defensive snaps, not special teams. Quarterback Jordan Love: 56 snaps Tyrod Taylor: 8 Backup quarterback Tyrod Taylor got in for the second time this season, his first since he kneeled down twice against the Chicago Bears. Taylor operated the offense on the last few drives of the game, when the Packers had already put away the game. No quarterback controversy here. Running Back Pierre Strong: 29 Kaleb Johnson: 26 Josh Jacobs: 9 The leading rusher on the night was Kaleb Johnson, who has been a healthy scratch as of lately. Johnson was pushed into action because of MarShawn Lloyd’s knee injury, and he split time on the field about 50-50 once starter Josh Jacobs left the game with a fractured finger . Between Lloyd, Jacobs and Chris Brooks, who only has two weeks left in his practice window , the Packers will need to make some tough decisions soon at the running back position. They’re dealing with three injuries, have five roster-caliber players, can only carry four on the 53-man roster (at most) and can only carry three on the game-day 48-man roster. At some point, something is going to have to give here. Receiver Christian Watson: 49 Matthew Golden: 48 Savion Williams: 30 J. Michael Sturdivant: 15 Bo Melton: 14 Coleman Owen: 8 Former practice squadder and current punt returner Coleman Owen got his first looks on offense in garbage time. He had not played on offense up to this point in the season. Owen was also pulled off the kickoff return unit, allowing Bo Melton to be the top returner with J. Michael Sturdivant as the “off-returner.” Belton had a 48-yard return that highlighted the night in the kicking game, while Owen had a 13-yard punt return. Oh, yeah. Christian Watson and Matthew Golden went off . sports.description: FOXBOROUGH – Gillette Stadium was rocking on Sunday. Before the Patriots ’ matchup with the Green Bay Packers , the organization honored the tenth anniversary of their 2016 Super Bowl team. That’s when the Patriots ran into a buzzsaw and sleepwalked through a terrible, no-good, very bad first quarter. The Gillette Stadium crowd was booing the Patriots at various points throughout the first half. Those boos continued Sunday as Mike Vrabel’s team was dominated from start to finish in this embarrassing 45-27 loss to the Packers. The 45 points allowed is the most by a Patriots team since 1990. sports.title: How Carlos Alcaraz and Rafael Nadal performed on their ATP Finals debuts as Rafael Jodar qualifies for 2026 event
sports.description: Rafael Jodar has achieved the unthinkable. The Spanish starlet has qualified for the ATP Finals, despite only turning professional at the start of this year . Jodar secured the eighth and final ATP Finals qualification spot following Carlos Alcaraz’s stunning comeback victory against Taylor Fritz in the Paris Masters quarter-finals. Speaking of Alcaraz, let’s take a look at how the Spanish magician – and fellow Spanish tennis legend Rafael Nadal – fared on his ATP Finals debut. Carlos Alcaraz’s ATP Finals debut Alcaraz qualified for the 2022 ATP Finals after winning his first Grand Slam title at the 2022 US Open. Unfortunately for the Spaniard, he was ultimately forced to withdraw from the event due to injury. Alcaraz again qualified in 2023, and on this occasion, injury would not prevent the Spaniard from making his tournament debut. Alcaraz, seeded second at the 2023 ATP Finals, advanced to the semi-finals after defeating Daniil Medvedev and Andrey Rublev in the group stage. Novak Djokovic swiftly ended Alcaraz’s hopes of a debut triumph, winning their semi-final contest 6-3, 6-2. “Best match of the tournament for me without a doubt,” Djokovic said afterwards. “It came at the right time, really, after spending a lot of hours on the court in the first three matches. I didn’t know how I’m going to feel. Carlos Alcaraz’s 2026 ATP Finals campaign Group stage: defeated Daniil Medvedev 6-4, 6-4 Group stage: defeated Andrey Rublev 7-5, 6-2 Group stage: lost to Alexander Zverev, 7-6, 3-6, 4-6 Semi-finals: lost to Novak Djokovic 3-6, 2-6 “But tonight from the very beginning I felt the ball well. I was approaching the match with the right attitude, right mentality.” Djokovic went on to win a record-breaking seventh ATP Finals title, beating Jannik Sinner in the final. Rafael Nadal’s ATP Finals debut Nadal, a 22-time Grand Slam champion, made his ATP Finals [then the Tennis Masters Cup] debut in 2006. Like Alcaraz, the Spanish superstar reached the semi-finals, beating Nikolay Davydenko and Tommy Robredo en route. Nadal, who qualified second in his group behind eighth seed James Blake, was beaten by Roger Federer in the semi-finals. Photo by FREDERIC J. BROWN / AFP via Getty Images “I am satisfied for finish the season with my best game, satisfied for that, because you finish the season with a very good feelings. That’s very important. And I am satisfied with my semifinal, yes,” Nadal said during his post-match press conference. “I win two matches against the two top eight players. And I lost against the No. 1 now today, but playing at very good level and good match, no? “So I am happy with the tournament, yes.” As for Federer, the Swiss star went on to the win the title in Shanghai, China, defeating James Blake in the final. The occasion marked Federer’s third ATP Finals title. Federer went on to win six titles in total, the last being in 2011. Despite reaching the final on two occasions, Nadal never won the ATP Finals.

sports.title: Did Hansi Flick get it right in Barcelona’s victory over Atletico Madrid?
sports.description: Atletico Madrid's Argentine coach Diego Simeone hugs Barcelona's German coach Hans-Dieter Flick prior the Spanish league football match between Club Atletico de Madrid and FC Barcelona at Metropolitano Stadium in Madrid on November 8, 2026. (Photo by Javier SORIANO / AFP via Getty Images) | AFP via Getty Images When you play Diego Simeone’s Atletico Madrid away from home , coming out of the lion’s den with a win is a plus no matter how you look at it. For Hansi Flick, there was also an opportunity to prove he learned his lessons against a team that had his number last season. Had Barcelona lost this game, which they very certainly could have, the chorus of criticism would have reached a fever pitch for a team that had already fallen to Real Madrid and PSG in recent weeks. The current coaching conditions are tough for Flick. His roster coming into the day continued to be light on good defensive options. That being said, help was on the way with Andreas Christensen and Eric Garcia making it back into the roster. Flick had choices to make, and in the end, he doubled down on his known biases. When I saw the starting eleven, I immediately felt cause for concern. Atleti has been one of the best teams at getting behind Barca’s backline, and Flick sent out João Cancelo and Brian Fariñas as his full-backs. A non-defending defender, and an academy midfielder deputizing as a full-back. In addition to that, he chose to play Marc Bernal instead of Frenkie de Jong in place of the injured Rodri. For me, the first half was a horror show. Simeone got everything right, while all Flick could do was pray for half-time to make changes. Luckily, Julián Alvarez missed a wide open opportunity to make it 2-0, and then Fermín López came to the rescue to even things up right before half-time, which totally changed the dynamic of the game. At the break, player changes were obviously needed for Barcelona. Flick made the right choice to bring in Frenkie de Jong, but the surprise choice of playing him as a full-back in place of Fariñas. It needs to be asked, what’s really going on with Alejandro Balde? At the moment, it looks like he’s completely locked out of the lineup with no chance back in on merit, and the sad part is, that decision is costing the team. Balde, I think many people would argue, would have been a better option than Cancelo in this game because it was a matchup that demanded physicality and good defending. Furthermore, all you ask of a coach is to be fair. When everyone is getting in front of your starting full-back from last season, no matter how many others fall to injury and fatigue, the coach must give a clear explanation, otherwise it’s starts to smell like personal feelings are coming before what’s in the best interest of the team. Fermín López was the man of the hour again. He’s the player that never quits, and it made all the difference against Atleti. science.title: Legendary sci-fi magazine 'Starlog' returns as a yearly release, just in time for its 50th anniversary
science.description: null "Starlog" was one of the greatest sci-fi and fantasy magazines ever, and after a 17-year absence, it's being resurrected. The legendary sci-fi mag went dark back in 2009 as part of the wave of popular publications folding due to years of declining readership and subscriptions. But as of Nov. 13, this geek favorite periodical returns as an annual print edition, and it's available for pre-order now. It’s another indication of digital fatigue in the world, and fans of a certain age will recall the pleasure of poring over each colorful issue packed with in-depth interviews, behind-the-scenes photos, TV guides, classic movie retrospectives, book reviews, con news, and VFX features. The triumphant relaunch of "Starlog" magazine happens on Nov. 13, 2026 (Image credit: Fangoria Holdings) "Starlog" launched in 1976, in the pre-" Star Wars " days, under the leadership of editor-in-chief Kerry O’Quinn. It first arrived with artist Jack Thurston's beautiful painted "Star Trek" cover, featuring William Shatner as Captain James T. Kirk and Leonard Nimoy’s Spock, set against the U.S.S. Enterprise near a shimmering black hole. The magazine continued to inform the science fiction community about upcoming sci-fi TV shows and blockbuster Hollywood films for over three decades; I fondly recall reading each informative and entertaining monthly issue cover-to-cover. Just in time to honor its 50th anniversary this year, "Starlog" blasts back into the sci-fi universe with Issue #375 showcasing cover artwork created by Armenian artist Gabriel Yeganyan. Its geek culture legacy, covering iconic franchises like "Star Wars," "Star Trek," and "Alien," will now live on thanks to Fangoria Holdings and io9 co-founder Annalee Newitz, editor-in-chief. Three vintage "Starlog" magazine issues from my personal collection! (Image credit: Jeff Spry) "During its original 33-year run, 'Starlog' documented science fiction as it evolved across film, television, books, technology, and culture," said 'Fangoria's Tara Ansley. "Fifty years after the magazine first launched, the line between science fiction and the real world has become increasingly difficult to separate. That makes this an especially interesting time to bring 'Starlog' back. Technology may change, but the most compelling questions have always been about people: how we live, what we create, and what kind of future we want to build." "Starlog" reloads for its first annual edition after a long hiatus on Nov. 13. You can pre-order the first issue (Issue 375 in continuity) on the Starlog website .

science.title: On this day in space! Nov. 8, 2005: Europe launches Venus Express, its first mission to Venus
science.description: null On Nov. 8, 2005, Europe launched its first mission to Venus. The spacecraft was called Venus Express. Venus is a hothouse planet, one where the atmospheric pressure can easily crush an unprotected spacecraft. Even from orbit, Venus Express had to survive harsh radiation. But the spacecraft lasted for more than nine years. During that time, Venus Express saw a weird vortex swirling around Venus's south pole . It also saw possible signs of active volcanoes . Venus Express also discovered that the planet generates its own auroras . These auroras happen when particles from the sun hit charged particles in the atmosphere. Late in the Venus Express mission, controllers told the spacecraft to dip down into Venus's clouds — even though the spacecraft wasn't designed to do this. It performed well, but eventually it stopped listening to commands. The spacecraft burned up in the atmosphere in January 2015. A Russian Soyuz rocket launches the Venus Express spacecraft to Venus on Nov. 8, 2005.. (Image credit: ESA) Why it mattered Venus Express established ESA as the third world organization to successfully send a probe to study Venus, following the United States and Soviet Union. (Japan's JAXA became the fourth five years later.) "By studying Venus, scientists learn how Earth-like planets change over time," reads a summary of the planet's exploration prepared by The Planetary Society. "Orbital studies [like Venus Express] hint that Venus may have hosted habitable oceans before becoming inhospitable." "By studying Venus, we can learn how Earth-like planets evolve and what shapes planets throughout the galaxy into temperate, lush worlds instead of sweltering hothouses. Venus also helps scientists model Earth’s climate, and may serve as a cautionary tale on how dramatically a planet’s climate can change," wrote the Society. An illustration of the Venus Express spacecraft in orbit around Venus. (Image credit: ESA) ESA returned to Venus in 2018 when BepiColombo, its joint mission with JAXA, used the planet's gravity to redirect its path toward the planet Mercury. Want more space history? science.title: Scientists simulate an Earth without life to help hunt for aliens and inhabited worlds
science.description: A new computer simulation that depicts Earth, or a rocky planet in general, without life is the latest tool in the quest to discover whether or not we are alone in the universe. Life leaves its mark on a planet, particularly its atmosphere, in the form of a mixture of biochemically created gases. Some are obvious, while others can be produced by both biology and geology, meaning that distinguishing a planet that has life from one that does not, solely based on what gases we can detect in its atmosphere, can be difficult. The key is in knowing which atmospheric conditions can be explained without life. To aid in distinguishing between habitable and inhabited planets, planetary scientist Samantha Gilbert-Janizek of the University of California, Riverside, developed a model that simulates the evolution of a rocky planet without life. "The model can help us see how habitable but non-living planets might mimic living planets," Gilbert-Janizek, who was a PhD student at the University of Washington when the research was conducted, said in a statement. Gilbert-Janizek built upon a model previously developed by Washington’s Rory Barnes that simulated the core, mantle, and crust of a planet. This new model pushed the simulation two steps further by incorporating the surface and atmosphere of the planet as well. In all, the model simulates 19 properties of a rocky planet that are not related to life, including the amount of heat a planet receives from its star , the exchange of heat and chemicals from the core to the surface, and the outflow of certain gases from the subsurface. Gilbert-Janizek’s starting point was to simulate the development of Earth had life never arisen here, therefore providing a baseline with which to compare to exoplanets . She ran the simulation from the birth of Earth 4.5 billion years ago to 500 million years into the future. The result was a lifeless world, but one that still had oceans and an atmosphere. "When we interpret observations of an exoplanet’s atmosphere, this tool will help us determine the probability that what we observe indicates life on the surface," said Gilbert-Janizek. An illustration shows the landscape of a primordial Earth before life arose as lightning splits the skies (Image credit: Robert Lea (created with Canva)) What makes the simulation especially useful is its plug-and-play nature. Researchers can simply apply the bulk properties of whichever planet they are studying to the model, and then just let it run. If the result is a planet with an atmosphere that matches what is detected spectroscopically by the James Webb Space Telescope or, in the future, the various extremely large 30-meter-plus ground-based telescopes or NASA’s planned Habitable Worlds Observatory , then we know that planet probably does not have life as we know it. Applications are now open for the agency’s next class of astronauts, who will join NASA as America returns to the Moon, builds the Moon Base, and lays the groundwork for the first crewed missions to Mars. The next generation of astronauts will train to operate on the lunar surface, live and work beyond Earth, and take on missions that will push the boundaries of human exploration farther than ever before. U.S. citizens interested in joining the astronaut corps have until 11:59 p.m. EST Thursday, Dec. 3, to submit their completed application materials at: https://go.nasa.gov/3WyvlQi “This is an extraordinary time to join NASA’s astronaut corps,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “The people we select could walk on the Moon, live and work at the Moon Base, and help pioneer the systems and operations that will ultimately carry crews to Mars. Those missions will demand technical excellence, sound judgment, teamwork, and courage. NASA’s astronaut corps has always called on remarkable Americans willing to take on extraordinary challenges in service to the nation. If you are ready to join that tradition, come help write the next chapter of humanity’s greatest adventure.” NASA expects to make its final selection in late 2027 to begin training as the next class of astronaut candidates. “The window is open. science.title: On this day in space! Nov. 7, 1992: NASA launches Mars Global Surveyor, its 1st Mars mission in 20 years at the time, to map the Red Planet like never before
science.description: null On Nov. 7, 1996, NASA launched its Mars Global Surveyor mission. This was the first mission NASA sent to Mars in almost 20 years! The Mars Global Surveyor spacecraft was an orbiter. It transmitted data from NASA's Mars rovers Sojourner , Spirit and Opportunity back to Earth. The spacecraft also did a lot of its own science. It found surface channels on Mars that appeared to have been created by running water. Mars Global Surveyor looked at the south pole of Mars and saw signs of possible climate change. It also saw a mineral called hematite on Mars. Hematite usually forms in water. NASA then sent its Spirit and Opportunity rovers to look for the hematite, and both rovers found it near their landing sites. Mars Global Surveyor survived much longer than expected. But a space maneuver accidentally exposed one of its batteries to the sun, and the spacecraft lost power. It fell silent forever in November 2006 . NASA launches the Mars Global Surveyor to Mars on a Delta II rocket on Nov. 7, 1996. (Image credit: NASA) Why it mattered As the first successful Mars mission since the two Viking launches in 1975, Mars Global Surveyor ushered in a new era of exploration of the Red Planet, not only through its own contributions to orbit-based science, but by serving a relay for surface-based rovers. As such, it became a primary pipeline for multiple concurrent Mars missions. "The [Mars Global Surveyor] mission overhauled scientists' understanding of Mars by studying the entire Martian surface, atmosphere and interior. Major findings included dramatic evidence that water still flows on Mars in short bursts down hillside gullies, and the identification of water-related mineral deposits leading to selection of a Mars rover landing site for a subsequent mission," read a NASA description of the probe. Mars Global Surveyor sent back more than 240,000 images to Earth during its nine active years. Want more space history? science.title: Send your name to Saturn's moon Titan with NASA's upcoming Dragonfly mission
science.description: null We still may be some time away from sending humans to distant reaches of the solar system, but you can send your name to Saturn's moon Titan, which has the ingredients of life on its surface thanks to NASA's Dragonfly mission. Dragonfly is an SUV-sized nuclear-powered rotorcraft that NASA aims to launch towards Titan in 2028. The agency opened a special events page in late October to allow members of the public to put their name on the spacecraft. The names will be put upon a chip on Dragonfly during the spacecraft's assembly, and all names must be submitted before Jan. 15, 2027. The agency says that the mission has no "ordinary itinerary," as Dragonfly aims to between areas miles (or kilometers) apart after arriving on the surface in 2034. "Nearly a billion miles away, an extraordinary destination awaits. Titan has an atmosphere, rivers and lakes, seasons, sweeping dunes and a landscape rich in organic material," NASA officials wrote in the event page. "Upon arrival in 2034, Dragonfly will fly from place to place on this intriguing world to uncover clues about this remarkable moon, and the chemistry that could help us understand the ingredients for life." Dragonfly will be one of just a few flying crafts on another world, with the first being NASA's plucky Ingenuity mini-helicopter that arrived on Mars along with the still-running Perseverance rover in 2021. Ingenuity was only designed to make five flights, but made it to 72 until its blades were damaged during a landing on Jan. 18, 2024. NASA is now planning a SkyFall mission on Mars that would use three helicopters, and which may launch as soon as late 2028 for the Red Planet. Dragonfly, however, is not the first mission to Titan: that would be Huygens , which operated for just a few hours on Jan. 14, 2005 after deploying from the Cassini spacecraft. Huygens was the first lander on an outer solar system world, and measured Titan's atmosphere and took data from the surface. (Image credit: NASA/JPL/University of Arizona/University of Idaho) For its part, Cassini flew by Titan more than 100 times before the mission concluded in September 2017 , providing valuable long-term data about the moon from above. Dragonfly aims to show the moon from up close for about 3.3 Earth years. Its destinations will include dunes and a young impact crater called Selk, according to NASA. "Dragonfly is expected to make one flight every one to two Titan days, which is called a Tsol and lasts about 16 Earth days," NASA officials added of the mission . Dragonfly will stop at a variety of geologic sites, where it will collect samples of surface material for analysis inside the rotorcraft by a suite of scientific instruments."
